🍎 shadowDragons/vsux (★49 · MIT · Swift 6.2 + AppKit + GhosttyKit)
1. Built Around Your Terminal AI Tools (No Built-in Agent Lock-in)
• Native macOS 14+ Apple Silicon app combining SwiftUI + AppKit + SHA-256 pinned GhosttyKit (~123MB)
• Multi-project sidebar + 4-way split PTY terminals + file editor + Git status/diff/stage/worktree
2. Review-Before-Run Command Library & Hardened Markdown Preview
Fill Terminal → Inserts saved command into PTY; human presses Return after review
Markdown Preview → Renders raw HTML as text; blocks remote & out-of-workspace URLs
Quick Tunnel → Wraps local port via cloudflared with explicit public URL prompt
Local Privacy → ~/Library/Application Support/vsux/ JSON · zero cloud accounts
3. Shortcuts & Multi-Project Supervision Workflow
• ⌘N New Window · ⌘T New Tab · ⌘D Split Right · ⌘⇧D Split Down · ⌘⇧F Find · ⇧⌘V Markdown Preview
• Supervise Claude Code / Copilot CLI in one project while background dev services & tests run in another
• Bilingual English & Simplified Chinese UI verified via swift test & check-localizations.py
Architectural Takeaway for AI Solution Architects:
When running 4–8 parallel CLI coding agents across repos, Electron IDEs bloat RAM while bare terminals
lose file/diff/service context. vsux embeds GhosttyKit PTYs with Git diff review, background service
logs, and Fill-Terminal human-in-the-loop safety in one native Apple Silicon binary.
🛡️ candygoogy/atieclxx-fix (★43 · MIT · PowerShell + Windows ACL Guard)
1. Root Cause: Missing amdkmpfd Setup Files Trigger 1Hz 677KB Copy Loop
• atieclxx.exe tries to install amdkmpfd PCI filter driver (.ctz/.itz/.stz removed after Adrenalin 26.3.1)
• Copies 677KB binary every 1s to systemprofile\AppData\Local\AMD\atieclxx.exe → 662 KB/s (40–55 GB/day)
2. Surgical 1-File SYSTEM ACL Deny vs Dangerous Workarounds
icacls "...\AMD\atieclxx.exe" /deny *S-1-5-18:(W,D) → 662 KB/s drops to 0 B/s
FreeSync / VRR Alive → Service stays running (PresentMon verified; 3.8KB/14m reboot)
Never sc delete → Deleting amdkmpfd causes INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE BSOD!
Adrenalin 26.11.1 → Fixed on RX 7000/9000; RX 6000 & Polaris/Vega still need fix
3. Self-Verifying 15-Second I/O Probe & Auto-Rollback
• -Check watches atieclxx.exe I/O write bytes for 15s without admin rights
• -Fix measures before/after; if writes don't stop or 26.11.1 fixed it, automatically lifts ACL block
• Survives reboots and DDU; prevents 20 TB/year of pointless SSD NAND wear per workstation
Architectural Takeaway for AI Solution Architects:
Instead of disabling vendor services (breaking VRR/FreeSync), toggling BIOS ReBAR (losing GPU perf),
or deleting boot filter drivers (causing BSOD), a targeted DACL deny on *S-1-5-18:(W,D) halts
runaway 20 TB/yr SSD wear in place with closed-loop 15s before/after telemetry verification.
